items.headline: 272-unit apartment building permitted on San Carlos St
items.summary: A new apartment building with 272 units has been permitted at 860 W San Carlos St, with a construction valuation of about $80.8 million. This is one of the larger multi-family projects cleared to build in the city recently.

items.headline: Seven detached ADUs permitted at single N 2nd St address
items.summary: Seven separate two-story accessory dwelling unit permits (units 9 through 15) were issued for 584 N 2nd St, each valued at about $568,988. The identical scope and same-day issuance suggest a coordinated multi-ADU buildout on one property rather than a single homeowner addition.

items.headline: Panel weighs allowing apartments in ROLM office zones
items.summary: Palo Alto's Economic Development Committee is reviewing a proposed zoning ordinance change that would let multi-family residential uses be conditionally permitted in the ROLM(E) office/research/manufacturing district, a shift from the district's current office-focused rules.
